title: Command line quiz
description: Ten questions on the shell commands we have used so far. There is no time limit and nothing is graded in the browser — we are collecting answers to look at together in class.

questions.question:
Given the session below, what does the last command print?

```
$ cat names.txt
anand
sriram
anand
$ sort names.txt | uniq | wc -l
```
Which command prints only the lines of `log.txt` that contain the word `error`?
You are in `/home/meera/notes`. What does `cd ..` followed by `pwd` print?

What is printed here?

```
$ echo hello > out.txt
$ echo world > out.txt
$ cat out.txt
```

What does the last command print?

```
$ ls
notes.txt  photo.jpg  report.pdf
$ ls *.txt
```

What is printed here?

```
$ echo one > f.txt
$ echo two >> f.txt
$ wc -l < f.txt
```
options: an error, because `>>` needs a file that exists

questions.question: What does `head -n 3 report.txt` do?
options: prints the first three lines of the file
prints the last three lines of the file
deletes the first three lines of the file

questions.question: You wrote a shell script and `./script.sh` says `Permission denied`. Which command fixes it?

What is the first line printed by this pipeline?

```
$ cat words.txt
apple
banana
apple
cherry
$ sort words.txt | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 1
```
What does `cd` with no arguments do?
options: stays where you are and prints the path
reports an error, because `cd` needs a directory
